document.abstract: Three kinds of motion-picture presentations are considered: (1) dramatic; (2) informational presentations for educational, technical, business and exhibit use; and (3) impact presentations for exhibits and expositions. An analysis of the psychophysical aspects of the human visual experience is evaluated for development of a new motion-picture viewing experience. Developmental and economic factors and potential audience capacity are discussed.
